Psilocybin, the compound in magic mushrooms, is being studied around the world for its potential to treat depression, anxiety, and addiction. But it's not a miracle drug. Used the wrong way, it can cause some serious harm too. This video is an attempt to remove the stigma around the substance, and look at the medical benefits of the drug in a responsible way. With the good and bad sides covered, we try to reflect upon whether or not India too should be researching the substance and legalising it.
